<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="240" height="260" viewBox="0 0 240 260" role="img" aria-labelledby="pot-title pot-description">
  <title id="pot-title">Guitar potentiometer — schematic top view</title>
  <desc id="pot-description">Round metal potentiometer housing with an unobstructed center for a schematic label, brown insulating terminal board and three solder lugs with transparent holes. Transparent background.</desc>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="pot-housing" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#eef0f1"/>
      <stop offset="0.35" stop-color="#cdd2d6"/>
      <stop offset="0.7" stop-color="#a7afb5"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#d9dde0"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="pot-rim" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0.2" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#f7f8f9"/>
      <stop offset="0.45" stop-color="#929ca4"/>
      <stop offset="0.75" stop-color="#e0e4e7"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#79848e"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="pot-terminal" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#a8afb3"/>
      <stop offset="0.45" stop-color="#f1f2ee"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#929b9f"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <g id="pot-lug">
      <path d="M-10,194 H10 V239 Q10,245 4,245 H-4 Q-10,245 -10,239 Z
               M-4,222 V234 A4,4 0 0 0 4,234 V222 A4,4 0 0 0 -4,222 Z"
            fill="url(#pot-terminal)" fill-rule="evenodd" stroke="#40474c" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
      <path d="M-6,207 H6" fill="none" stroke="#747d83" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    </g>
    <g id="pot-crimp">
      <path d="M-8,-82 H8 L7,-73 H-7 Z" fill="url(#pot-rim)" stroke="#747e86" stroke-width="1.1" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    </g>
  </defs>
  <!-- Phenolic board and three independent solder terminals. -->
  <rect x="44" y="164" width="152" height="43" rx="10" fill="#9e633f" stroke="#4c3327" stroke-width="2"/>
  <path d="M51,199 H189" fill="none" stroke="#c18a60" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <g transform="translate(70 0)"><use href="#pot-lug"/></g>
  <g transform="translate(120 0)"><use href="#pot-lug"/></g>
  <g transform="translate(170 0)"><use href="#pot-lug"/></g>
  <g fill="#d2b47a" stroke="#64482e" stroke-width="1.2">
    <circle cx="70" cy="197" r="4"/>
    <circle cx="120" cy="197" r="4"/>
    <circle cx="170" cy="197" r="4"/>
  </g>
  <!-- Stamped circular housing; the center is left clear for a label. -->
  <circle cx="120" cy="106" r="86" fill="url(#pot-rim)" stroke="#343b41" stroke-width="2.5"/>
  <circle cx="120" cy="106" r="79" fill="url(#pot-housing)" stroke="#8a949c" stroke-width="1.4"/>
  <path d="M47,91 A75,75 0 0 1 156,40" fill="none" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-opacity="0.8" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <g transform="translate(120 106)">
    <use href="#pot-crimp"/>
    <use href="#pot-crimp" transform="rotate(60)"/>
    <use href="#pot-crimp" transform="rotate(120)"/>
    <use href="#pot-crimp" transform="rotate(180)"/>
    <use href="#pot-crimp" transform="rotate(240)"/>
    <use href="#pot-crimp" transform="rotate(300)"/>
  </g>
</svg>
name: Pot
